name: Sofya
description: Web intelligence API for AI agents. search returns full page content instead of snippets, fetch converts URLs and PDFs to markdown, extract pulls structured data, and research decomposes a question into sub-queries and returns a cited report. Hosted streamable HTTP MCP at https://mcp.sofya.co/mcp with bearer auth. 4 tools (search, fetch, extract, research). Free tier of 1,000 credits/month for GitHub accounts, then $0.005/credit. Install: claude mcp add --transport http sofya https://mcp.sofya.co/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer ay_live_...".
